mutants.desc: a true simultaneous read+write increments the count
the write half of a simultaneous read+write is dropped (count still right)
the read pointer does not advance on a simultaneous read+write
a write at full is accepted when a read happens on the same edge
a read at empty is accepted when a write happens on the same edge
reset is skipped on any cycle where wr_en is high
reset does not clear the count
reset does not clear the read pointer
reset does not clear the write pointer
read pointer wraps one slot early
write pointer wraps to slot 1 instead of slot 0
a read-only cycle increments the count
the count stops at DEPTH-1, so full never asserts
full compares against DEPTH+1 and never asserts
empty is derived from pointer equality, so it also asserts at full
a dropped write still writes memory and moves wr_ptr (overwrites the head)
an ignored read still advances the read pointer
the MSB of every stored word is forced to 0
bit 0 of a stored word is XORed with bit 7 (coupling fault)
slot 5, bit 3 reads back stuck at 1
with count==1 and both enables high, rd_data shows wr_data instead of the head
while empty, rd_data shows wr_data (a live bypass of the input bus)
while empty, rd_data is forced to zero instead of the stale slot
full derived from pointer equality plus a nonzero count (logically identical)
